plugin-books.hardcoverNoMatch: Hardcover found no matching book. Showing Open Library.
plugin-books.hardcoverAuth: Hardcover could not authenticate (HTTP 401). Re-enter or renew the token in plugin settings. Showing Open Library.
plugin-books.hardcoverLimit: Hardcover request limit reached. Showing Open Library.
plugin-books.hardcoverUnavailable: Hardcover is unavailable. Showing Open Library.

hardcoverToken.label: Hardcover API token
hardcoverToken.description: Optional. Add your token from Hardcover account settings → Hardcover API. Books uses Hardcover first and falls back to Open Library. The token stays on the server. Only read:catalog:search is needed; read:catalog also includes it. Paste the complete hc_pat_ token.

plugin-books.hardcoverFormat: The Hardcover token format is invalid. Paste the complete hc_pat_ token from your account settings. Supported OAuth and legacy JWT tokens also work. Showing Open Library.
plugin-books.hardcoverScope: Hardcover reports insufficient permissions (HTTP 403). Enable read:catalog:search, then save the plugin settings again. Showing Open Library.
plugin-books.hardcoverForbidden: Hardcover denied the search request (HTTP 403). This does not necessarily mean the token is invalid. Showing Open Library.
